Bangkok Protests Against IMF and World Bank Meetings

Hundreds of protesters marched through Bangkok on Thursday, October 15, to oppose the annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and World Bank. Protesters decried the institutions and warned of destructive capitalism, citing growing inequality.
